newsitem.title: USA: GTE Corp hires former CEO of Spain's TISA.
newsitem.headline: GTE Corp hires former CEO of Spain's TISA.

text.p: GTE Corp said Monday it had hired Ignacio Santillana, former chief executive of Spain's Telefonica Internacional SA (TISA), as senior vice president of international business development, effective February 3.
"He will have worldwide responsibility for expanding GTE's international activities, building on the company's solid base of operations and emerging opportunities," GTE said in a release.

It also said it had named Bruce Haddad as senior vice president of international operations in charge of operations in Canada, Asia and Latin America "as well as any operations GTE may acquire or build worldwide."
Haddad is a 20-year veteran of GTE.
